name: lumabar 1.2.29
body:
- New: Search does what you type - "volume 30", "make the dock bigger", "dock to the top" - in any language.
- Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.28
body:
- New: Pick tray icons to show right on the dock, in a line (Tray > Show on the dock).
- New: Group windows - turn it off and every window of an app gets its own numbered icon, which you can put anywhere (Settings > Dock).
- New: Device Batteries - battery rings for your PC and connected Bluetooth devices.
- New: Clean widget style (Settings > Appearance).
- New: Up to six cities in World Clocks, and a city setting in the Clock & Weather tile's menu.
- New: Close dock in Settings gives the Windows taskbar back.
- Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.27
body:
- New: Eject a USB drive from Quick Toggles - the button comes up by itself when you plug one in.
- New: Open file location in an app's right-click menu.
- New: Middle-click an app to open another window.
- New: Magnification speed - slow, normal or fast (Settings > Dock).
- New: A Sync button in the Calendar for your Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars.
- New: No pop-ups over fullscreen apps - they wait until you're back.
- Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.26
body: - Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.25
body:
- New: Dock profiles - group your widgets and switch with one click above the dock or in the right-click menu.
- New: Corner radius - a square or a round dock; the widgets and their logos follow (Settings > Dock).
- New: The profile switcher's size and place, and the arrow keys and Enter to switch.
- New: The arrow keys in the widget picker - Enter adds the widget.
- Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.24
body:
- New: A redesigned Screen Time card, in the Calendar's style.
- New: Make the dock smaller than before (Settings > Dock > Size).
- New: Saves battery while Windows Energy Saver is on.
- Smoother glass corners, lighter on the CPU.
- Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.23
body:
- New: Put the dock at the top or bottom of the screen (Settings > Dock > Position).
- Smoother, lighter glass.
- Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.22
body:
- New: A redesigned Calendar, with a small time picker for new events.
- New: "Keep in recordings" (Settings > Appearance, glass styles) - for NVIDIA Instant Replay and game capture.
- Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.21
body:
- New: Pick which screen the dock sits on (Settings > Dock > Display, with two or more screens) - Start, apps and screenshots open there too.
- New: The To-do shortcut (Alt+T) can be turned off in Settings.
- Bug fixes and improvements.

name: lumabar 1.2.20
body:
- New: WhatsApp tile - unread chats and the latest message.
- New: Top CPU and Top RAM tiles - the apps using the most right now.
- New: Open indicator setting - a dot, a large dot or a line under open apps.
- New: Win+1 to Win+0 open the apps on your dock.
- New: OpenCode in the AI Limits tile.
- The dock starts sooner after you sign in.
- One-colour app icons follow the dock's shade.
- End task sits above Close window in an app's menu.
- Zoom's buttons just above the dock take every click.
- Your key is taken back on the same PC, rotated keys too, and the paywall says why when a key is refused.
- A stronger license check.

name: lumabar 1.2.19
body:
- New: Keyboard tile (opens and closes the On-Screen Keyboard)
- Fixed: Steam game icons
- Fixed: unpinning Store apps (Spotify and others)
- Fixed: dock top edge after switching from glass to white
- Fixed: currency amount kept
- Improved: lower CPU and memory at idle

name: lumabar 1.2.18
body:
- New: app badges - unread counts from Telegram, Discord and other apps on their dock icons.
- New: AI Limits tile - two AI tools' limits on one tile, all of them in its card.
- New: Notifications tile - opens and closes Windows notifications.
- New: App icons setting - small, medium or large, the Start logo too.
- New: App cards setting - apps on cards or just their icons.
- New: click a weather tile for the next hours and the week ahead.
- Back: the crypto tile - BTC/USDT and up to three Binance pairs.
- Improved: the temperature tile shows the sensor you pick.
- Improved: RAM and CPU tiles open Task Manager.
- Improved: buttons, apps and toggles press with a smooth animation.
- Improved: a cleaner Search Console card.
- Improved: smaller app group cards.
- Improved: Sound and Brightness sliders redesigned.
- Fixed: app groups not opening on a second click.
- Fixed: glass staying black after start.
- Fixed: Discord showing twice.
- Fixed: tray icons - double-click works, sharper icons.
- Fixed: the Windows taskbar coming back after a restart.
- Fixed: Storage tile showing a different number than its card.
- Fixed: blurry icons for Zoom and other apps.
- Fixed: apps hidden from the taskbar showing on the dock.
- Fixed: Claude and Grok tiles now say how to reconnect.
- Fixed: the auto-hidden dock coming back with the old window's color.

name: lumabar 1.2.17
body:
- New: open an app group and rest on a running app to see its windows live.
- Improved: a cleaner Search Console tile.
- Fixed: magnified apps not taking a click on the part of the icon above the dock's edge.

name: lumabar 1.2.16
body:
- Fixed: the dock flashing when you right-click it.
- Fixed: the dock changing height on right-click - magnified apps stay put while a menu is open.
- Fixed: the dock looking slightly bigger when you point at it.
- Fixed: widgets shifting when Start opens or closes.

name: lumabar 1.2.15
body:
- New: Do Not Disturb tile.
- Improved: apps show their own icons again, on cards that match your dock.
- Improved: bigger app icons - every app is the size of a widget card, the lumabar logo too.
- Fixed: the Claude tile says when Claude Code's sign-in expired instead of a stuck 0%.
- Fixed: window previews closing before you reach them with magnification on.
- Fixed: Weather Status text on the dock.
- Fixed: log files filling up on PCs without Wi-Fi.

name: lumabar 1.2.14
body:
- New: Mac-style magnification - apps grow as you hover the dock, with a size slider.
- New: macOS-style app icons.
- New: app groups on the Apps tile - drop one app on another.
- New: four battery tiles - Ring, Core, Dots and Gauge.
- New: apps light up on the dock when they need you.
- New: a Padding setting, and spacing up to 24 px.
- New: Widgets and Settings in every app's right-click menu.
- New: the widget picker marks apps already on the dock.
- Improved: Now Playing and Weather tiles redesigned.
- Improved: menus and cards open with a smooth fade.
- Fixed: the dock hiding when you take a screenshot.
- Fixed: a box flashing above the dock.
- Fixed: removed apps coming back on Windows 10.
- Fixed: Command Prompt and PowerShell on the dock show as open and minimize.
- Fixed: the dock blinking when you click an app.
- Removed: docks on other screens - the dock lives on the main screen.
- Removed: Float over windows.
- Removed: World Clock, Analog Classic, System Stats, Recent Screenshots, Downloads, Metric, Stock and Weather Forecast tiles.

name: lumabar 1.2.13
body:
- New: apps and folders on the dock work like taskbar buttons - open dot, click to minimize, previews, jump lists. Groups too.
- New: Microphone tile - mute and deafen for every app.
- New: wallpapers that change daily or weekly, from one theme or all.
- New: Auto-hide > Show on desktop - the dock stays up on an empty desktop.
- New: info tips on every dock setting.
- New: a What's new link on the update notice.
- Fixed: SourceTree and other apps crashing while the Tray tile is on.
- Fixed: a File Explorer tile appearing with the desktop's right-click menu.
- Fixed: notch apps showing as open windows.

name: lumabar 1.2.12
body:
- New: Show Desktop tile.
- New: your Polar milestones on the calendar.
- Improved: the Hidden / Auto-hide taskbar choice is back.
- Improved: app previews show the window's title and a close button.
- Fixed: TikTok and Instagram follower counts.
- Fixed: restoring apps from the dock.
- Fixed: Store app pins on the dock.
- Fixed: smoother glass on high-resolution screens.
- Fixed: connecting Google Calendar.
- Fixed: memory usage shown correctly.

name: lumabar 1.2.11
body:
- New: the Windows key brings an auto-hidden dock up together with Start, the way the taskbar does, and it slides away again when Start closes.
- New: the Windows taskbar stays out of the way on every screen with a dock (its setting is gone), and comes back when you close or quit lumabar.
- Fixed: crisper text on the dock, and sharp app icons on high-resolution screens.
- Fixed: maximized apps reach the dock - the thin line between them (Edge, Chrome and other apps) is gone.
- Fixed: from this version on, the update notice stays until you press Update or close it, and a closed one waits in Settings; new versions are looked for every 10 minutes.
- Fixed: stocks refresh every minute and come back on their own when the PC wakes up before its Wi-Fi does, keeping the last price meanwhile.
- Fixed: the Storage tile shows "Full in N days" on its own line instead of squeezing the free space.
- Fixed: under a fullscreen game or video the dock stops drawing, so the game keeps its frames; TikTok LIVE Studio counts as a screen recorder.
- Fixed: with a dock on every display, the other screen's dock no longer flashes over a fullscreen video.
- Fixed: the To-do tile opens its list again after tasks were done.
- Fixed: docks with many widgets use far less CPU - widgets scrolled out of view rest.

name: lumabar 1.2.10
body:
- New: a chart in the AI usage cards - how a limit was used through its window, and where it is headed by the reset.
- New: a redesigned Storage card - switch drives at the top, see what takes the space at a glance.
- New: the Sound card in iOS style - a Control Center volume slider, each app's own volume, your outputs as a checklist.
- New: a redesigned Search Console card - clicks, impressions and the chart on one side, top queries and pages on the other.
- New: feedback you send includes how much CPU and memory lumabar uses, so problems are found faster.
- Fixed: dragging Settings > Dock > Size resizes the dock smoothly (with the glass styles it still follows in steps).
- Fixed: scrolling the dock sideways with the mouse wheel glides instead of jumping, and a touchpad swipe no longer scrolls twice as far.
- Fixed: after the PC sleeps, the dock comes back instead of leaving an empty strip.
- Fixed: apps dragged out of the Start menu (DaVinci Resolve, MSI Dragon Center and others) are pinned as apps, not added as letter tiles that open nothing.
- Fixed: the Widgets menu lists every installed app - the ones in Start menu folders, taskbar pins and Office apps included.
- Fixed: a file deleted elsewhere leaves the dock.
- Fixed: bigger, easier-to-read text on the tiles.
- Fixed: the Cursor widget works with Cursor 3.27 and newer - it no longer asks you to sign in while Cursor is signed in.
- Fixed: Claude's limits stay on the dock after a restart or a reboot and while Claude Code is closed; they refresh while you use Claude Code, and every 15 minutes otherwise.
- Fixed: the OpenCode widget shows your usage again.
- Fixed: AI tiles always show when each limit resets.
- Fixed: revenue tiles show short amounts ($1.5k), and the Total revenue card no longer scrolls.
- Fixed: the World Clock tile shows just the city and its time.
- Fixed: a card no longer opens in the middle of the screen after Settings was closed, and tall cards no longer open past the top of a small screen.
- Fixed: the right-click menu highlights its rows at once.

name: lumabar 1.2.9
body:
- New: drag the dock's size in Settings > Dock > Size, from smaller than the Windows taskbar to big enough for a 1440p screen - the dock follows as you drag.
- New: raise the dock off the edge of the screen with Settings > Dock > Distance from edge.
- New: Float over windows - the dock stays on top and maximized windows use the whole screen under it.
- New: Windows and MacBook wallpapers in the wallpaper gallery, and every tab shows landscape pictures only.
- New: the Notes tile shows the note you wrote last.
- Fixed: Screen Time no longer stops counting (and shows 0m) after a browser tab with Cyrillic text or emoji in its title.
- Fixed: with two monitors, the dock no longer comes up over a fullscreen game or video when you click on the other screen.
- Fixed: with Float over windows or Auto-hide on, the dock hides for fullscreen video and comes back after it.
- Fixed: the Temperature card names the sensor it reads - a desktop's board sensor is no longer called the CPU.
- Fixed: the Gmail tile shows 12k instead of 12323.
- Fixed: Launch at startup shows Off when lumabar is switched off in Task Manager's Startup apps, turning it on switches it back on there, and the startup entry always points at the installed app.

name: lumabar 1.2.8
body:
- New: Google Search Console on your dock - clicks and impressions with their trend. Its card shows your top queries, pages, countries and devices, and checks whether a page is indexed.
- New: the Gmail card lists your inbox, unread or starred mail, and searches it.
- New: the currency widget finds any of 152 currencies by country or name - in English, Uzbek or Russian, typos and all.
- New: each app's own volume - click the volume widget for a mixer, like Windows' Volume mixer.
- New: Storage shows every drive - pick D: or a USB stick, and the tile shows that one.
- New: Energy saver and Do not disturb in Quick Toggles.
- New: drag the space between widgets in Settings > Dock > Spacing.
- New: the battery of your Bluetooth headphones, mouse or keyboard, beside them in the Bluetooth card.
- New: °C or °F right in the Temperature card.
- New: a check mark in the Widgets menu on every widget already on your dock.
- Fixed: the dock uses far less CPU while music plays and with live charts on it, and gives memory back while a fullscreen game or video covers it.
- Fixed: Screen Time no longer misses time on a busy PC or on battery.
- Fixed: signing out of Gmail or Search Console can no longer be undone by a sign-in refresh at the same moment.

name: lumabar 1.2.7
body:
- Fixed: the auto-hiding dock no longer flashes white as it comes back - it slides in and out like the Windows taskbar.
- Fixed: app names no longer flash up while the dock slides in under the pointer.
- Fixed: the dock slides in smoothly, with its glass refreshed once it is in place.

name: lumabar 1.2.6
body:
- New: put any app or folder on the dock as a widget of its own - pick it in the Widgets menu's Apps & Files.
- New: app groups, as on an iPhone - hold one app over another for a moment and let go. A click opens the group; its name is yours to change.
- New: an app's right-click shows its jump list - Telegram's Quit, Brave's New window, Terminal's profiles, the files you opened last.
- New: the Start button's right-click is Windows' own quick menu, with Shut down or sign out.
- New: drag files over an open app - Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Slack - and it comes to the front, so you drop them straight into it.
- New: Pin to dock on an open app's right-click.
- New: the Timer takes hours, minutes and seconds, and keeps your own lengths.
- New: your own accent colour, and window previews you can turn off.
- New: a red dot shows what is new - in Settings, the Widgets menu and the right-click menus.
- Fixed: the Windows taskbar no longer comes back beside an auto-hiding dock.
- Fixed: the Widgets menu opens noticeably faster.
- Fixed: an account that is not connected yet offers Connect and its setup guide, not Log out.
- Fixed: Store apps like Terminal and Notepad can be pinned and moved among your pins.
- Fixed: the dock no longer blinks in OBS and other screen recordings.

name: lumabar 1.2.5
body:
- New: End task on an open app's right-click, for an app that stopped answering.
- New: File Explorer's right-click lists your Quick access folders, as the taskbar's does.
- New: a click on any clock or date opens the Calendar - the dates and events ahead.
- New: a widget's card opens right over the widget, not in the middle of the dock.
- Fixed: cards, menus and app previews come out of the bar with a proper slide.
- Fixed: an app's preview shows sooner on hover, and a right-click swaps it for the app's menu.
- Fixed: the Gemini widget keeps Antigravity's last reading on the tile while Antigravity is closed.

name: lumabar 1.2.4
body:
- New: a dock on every display - Settings > Dock > Displays > All. Each one keeps its own space above its screen's windows.
- New: a dock that follows the pointer - Displays > Follow: hold the pointer at the bottom of another screen and the dock moves there.
- New: Lock dock (Settings > Dock): widgets move only while the Widgets menu is open, and the dock stays where it is.
- Fixed: the Gemini widget reads Antigravity, now that Google has ended the Gemini CLI sign-in - the session and weekly limits, and the model you used most this week.

name: lumabar 1.2.3
body:
- New: a Mac-style Trash on the dock - drop files on it to recycle them, and it fills up as the Recycle Bin does.
- Fixed: a pinned Store app (Outlook, Teams) no longer shows a second icon while it is open; an app's windows all show on hover instead of a stacked icon.
- Fixed: the dock keeps its space above your windows from the first moment after Windows starts.
- Fixed: activation and widgets work behind networks that inspect traffic (Zscaler and the like).
- Fixed: pressing Update twice no longer downloads the update twice.

name: lumabar 1.2.2
body: - Fixed: the Claude widget showed two to three times too many tokens - a reply was counted once for every part of it (its thinking, its text, each tool call). Each reply now counts once.

name: lumabar 1.2.1
body:
- Fixed: lumabar uses far less memory with the Claude widget - it reads only what is new in your Claude Code history instead of all of it every minute.
- Fixed: the dock shows up about 3 seconds sooner every time lumabar starts.
- Fixed: with the Clear style and glass widgets on a narrower dock, a widget scrolling out at the dock's edge keeps its rounded corners.

name: lumabar 1.2.0
body:
- New: Auto-hide - the dock slides away while you work and comes back when the pointer touches the screen edge (Settings > Dock).
- New: Win+T shows your open apps the way the taskbar does - the arrows move between apps, Tab between their windows, Enter opens one.
- New: Ethernet in Quick Toggles; Wi-Fi shows only on PCs that have it.
- New: with the Clear style, widgets can be black, white or frosted glass.
- New: an open app's preview shows on hover even with one window, and resting on it shows the window itself.
- New: an update downloads right in its toast, with its progress - closing the toast does not stop it.
- Fixed: the glass dock picks up a new wallpaper, and the desktop again after the PC is unlocked.
- Fixed: the Claude widget and its card show the same numbers.
- Bug fixes.

name: lumabar 1.1.1
body:
- New: the Widgets menu opens faster, and its sidebar follows you as you scroll - click a category to jump to it.
- New: every open app on the dock can be dragged to a new place, Store apps too.
- New: window screenshots take exactly the window, rounded corners included.
- New: on the calendar, a day with several items shows two logos side by side, then "+N".
- Optimizations.
- Bug fixes.

name: lumabar 1.1.0
body:
- New: Automations - the dock pauses your music before meetings, warns you before an AI limit runs out, reminds you before a plan renews and turns review requests into to-dos. Quiet hours keep it silent at night.
- New: one Calendar for everything - meetings, payouts, renewals and limit resets, plus your Google, Outlook or iCloud calendars.
- New: Day Timeline - your whole day on one line.
- New: a monthly revenue goal, the Album art accent, the Clear dock style and text from screenshots.
- Optimizations.
- Bug fixes.

name: lumabar 1.0.2
body:
- New: Shopify, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle and Gumroad revenue widgets - today, the week and 30 days, with a chart tile for each.
- New: Plausible visitors, Dub clicks, Resend emails, Linear issues and Supabase project widgets, each with your own key.
- New: Instagram followers, with an official Instagram token.
- Every chart tile now looks the same: the week's number and how it moved, over a filled line.
- Each connect card links to a step-by-step guide for that widget: https://lumabar.xyz/docs#accounts
- Clearer messages when a key can't read what a widget needs (a send-only Resend key, a Supabase token without the right access).
- Drag the dock from the gaps between widgets, too.
- The dock's corners and spacing line up evenly around the widgets.
- Lighter on the CPU: widgets redraw only when what they show changes.

name: lumabar 1.0.1
body:
lumabar 1.0.1 - a smaller tray and language switcher, a dock you can narrow, billing dates on the AI usage cards.

- New: drag either end of the dock to make it narrower - down to one tile; scroll to reach the rest. Double-click an end to go back to full width.
- Tray: one chevron on the dock, your tray icons in a grid on click. Right-clicking an app there keeps the card open while its menu is up.
- Language: just the current layout on the dock, the list on click.
- AI usage cards redesigned, in the Quick Toggles look. Claude opens one too, with your plan, its last and next charge, and extra usage.
- Cursor, Grok and ChatGPT cards show when the plan was last billed and when it renews.
- Settings and other Store apps show their own icon instead of a generic one.
- Music: the playing mini player no longer makes the tiles next to it shimmer.
- The glass dock blinks less in screen recordings.
- Bug fixes.

name: lumabar 1.0.0
body:
lumabar 1.0 - drag and drop on the dock, Screen Time, Temperature, your own accent colour.

- New: drag an app from the desktop or Explorer onto the dock to pin it.
- New: photos, videos, files and folders on the dock; a folder shows what is inside it.
- Move any icon along the dock, the lumabar icon too; drag one off to remove it.
- New: Screen Time - your apps (and websites, if you turn it on) by day and by week, with a daily summary.
- New: Temperature - the CPU's heat, every sensor, the last ten minutes, CPU and memory load.
- New: pick your own accent colour.
- Redesigned Settings.
- Music widgets: a playing animation, and the app's icon when there is no cover.
- Bug fixes.

name: lumabar 0.1.14
body:
Shortcuts, more quick toggles, a glass update toast.

- New: Alt+T opens To Do from anywhere.
- New: Microphone, Camera, Keep Awake, Desktop Icons and Display Mode toggles.
- New: Clock & Weather and seven-segment clock tiles.
- New: seconds on the clock; scroll on Audio Output to change the volume.
- Redesigned theme button and update toast.
- Bug fixes.

name: lumabar 0.1.13
body:
Smoother glass, Quick Toggles you pick.

- New: choose which toggles sit in the Quick Toggles tile.
- Toggles slide in and out like dock widgets.
- Smoother glass, also at full width.
- Bug fixes.

name: lumabar 0.1.12
body:
Feedback with screenshots and recordings, a Stopwatch, a DataFast chart.

- New: Stopwatch widget.
- New: feedback with screenshots and screen recordings.
- Redesigned DataFast tile; more stats in the DataFast card.
- Collapse removed.
- Bug fixes.

name: lumabar 0.1.11
body:
Right-click that behaves, a dock that stays put, a scrolling network graph.

- Right-click on a tile's icon (any play button, checkbox or chart line) opens the menu again - the target was read as an SVG element and treated as no target at all.
- A right-click inside a card now opens the dock's menu instead of being swallowed; the widget picker keeps its slot; the app tile's menu no longer flickers.
- Another appbar (a Windhawk taskbar mod, the Command Palette panel) can no longer walk the dock up the screen.
- The Network chart glides at display rate instead of ticking once a second; both widgets.
- Unpinning an app now animates away like a widget removal does, and its neighbours slide over.
- Dock padding and the widget gap halved at every size; a full-width bar splits its vertical inset evenly; the dock's corner radius now follows the widgets' concentrically; Timer and Pomodoro drop the default grey hairline.

name: lumabar 0.1.10
body: lumabar 0.1.10

name: lumabar 0.1.9
body: lumabar 0.1.9
